start.content: I am Claudius. I hold the Antonia fortress. I do not hold opinions about every prophet. But I do have a servant paralysed at home. I sent word: come heal my servant. He did not come. He replied: 'Go your way; let it be done according to your faith.' The servant was healed before the messenger reported back.
